name: rizkyfadhillahid/event-connect-root
description: Root composer to run all services (backend and frontends) in Capstone Event Connect

dev: node backend/node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd,#a7f3d0,#fdba74,#86efac,#fef08a,#f472b6" "cd backend && php artisan serve" "cd backend && php artisan queue:listen --tries=1 --timeout=0" "cd backend && php artisan reverb:start" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix backoffice" "npm run dev --prefix tenant" "npm run dev --prefix website" --names="api,queue,reverb,vite-back,backoffice,tenant,website" --kill-others
